At the start of this final installment of Stephen King’s trilogy featuring the retired police detective Bill Hodges, his hero is “pushing 70” and getting bad news from his doctor. Just how bad may be ominously presaged by the title. But Hodges, who runs a small private agency called Finders Keepers with his partner, Holly Gibney, is preoccupied by some other news that may be just as bad.
